name: lag-default
citation: assumption pending transcription of adult stimulus-response data (a published lag of roughly 0.3-0.7 D at 3 D demand; see spec §4.2). minTargetDistanceM is a numerical guard against a zero-distance target, not a physiological value.
note: Approximation. Label as such in the UI tooltip of the accommodation readout. Replace this file with a published adult stimulus-response curve when one can be transcribed (for example with the Zapata-Díaz 2019 model).
